design: white/gold armoured angelic warrior, lavender accents, gold pointed-ear helmet, glowing halo, white feathered wings
source: celestfur-squad-living/final/*.png — 29 strips, 320x360 per frame, transparent RGBA; frame counts and verdicts per celestfur-squad-living/manifest.json
method: Each 320x360 frame scaled aspect-preserving to 85x96 (height 96, width 320*96/360=85.33 rounded to 85) with LANCZOS, centred horizontally (x offset 5) in its 96x96 cell, RGBA preserved. No frames dropped, invented, repeated, or redrawn. WebP lossless. Repo convention checked: tools/sprite-cut/cut_grid.py and your/assets/SHEETS.json (96px square cells everywhere, all facing right, engine mirrors for left) — note: cut_grid.py crops each cell to its content bbox and bottom-anchors at max 90px; this cut follows the task spec instead (whole-frame scale to 85x96, centred), so wing tips at cell edges are preserved rather than re-cropped.
facing_note: Run frames face mixed directions (e.g. qb-01 run frame 1 faces left, the rest face right); per-cell facing was not verified. All strips are recorded as facing right per repo convention; the engine mirrors for left.
positions_are_positional: Squad strips are positional (QB-01 etc.), NOT named characters — no named character is mapped to any positional strip.

block.pad_cells: ol-60 (row 4) and ol-72 (row 5) have only 5 frames; column 6 of those rows is intentionally transparent — no frame invented or repeated.
